#summary How to get in contact with us or receive news about EMF Client Platform.

=== Bug Reports and Feature Requests ===

You can report bugs and feature requests in the [https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/enter_bug.cgi?product=EMFT.emfclient bugzilla of Eclipse].

=== Questions ===

Please ask any questions on the 
[http://www.eclipse.org/forums/index.php?t=thread&frm_id=207&S=54729736cf71d8ae16fa32e781b9e0b3 newsgroup.]


=== Twitter ===

We announce import news such as releases on Twitter:
http://twitter.com/emfcp
We always use the #emfcp tag.

=== Blog ===

We write a blog were we announce news about the UNICASE project including the EMF Client Platform and our experiences on technologies we use in EMFStore:
http://unicase.blogspot.com

=== Plain Email ===

Of course you can also send direct email to one of the project leads:
